measure.$description: Maximum inline measure for a prose blockquote.

spacing-before.$description: Incoming spacing request when a blockquote follows another direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-before and the previous treatment's spacing-after, so structural hierarchy wins without relying on source order.

spacing-after.$description: Outgoing spacing request contributed by a blockquote to the next direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-after and the next treatment's spacing-before; documented compound pairs may intentionally use the tighter outgoing gap.

padding-inline-start.$description: Inline-start inset between the quote rule and its content.

border-color.$description: Color of the blockquote's inline-start rule.

border-width.$description: Width of the blockquote's inline-start rule.

border-style.$description: Style of the blockquote's inline-start rule.

paragraph-spacing.$description: Block spacing between consecutive paragraphs inside a blockquote.

cite-spacing-before.$description: Block spacing before a blockquote citation.

cite-font-family.$description: Font family for a blockquote citation.

cite-font-size.$description: Font size for a blockquote citation.

cite-font-weight.$description: Font weight for a blockquote citation.

cite-line-height.$description: Line height for a blockquote citation.

cite-letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing for a blockquote citation.

cite-color.$description: Text color for a blockquote citation.

cite-font-style.$description: Font style for a blockquote citation.

cite-text-transform.$description: Text transform for a blockquote citation.
